The [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Vexx]] employed a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''bodyguard''' as part of his [[Vexx's Crew|crew]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. In [[3643 BBY]], the [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] and a number of Vexx's other men stood guard in a hangar of [[Jiguuna Spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] while Vexx waited to board a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] there. A [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] entered the hangar and [[Death/Legends|killed]] at least fifteen of the men guarding Vexx and then Vexx himself in order to claim a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on the smuggler.

==Biography==
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] worked as the [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] for the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and gunslinger [[Vexx]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Sending a Message" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> the [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] and eighteen other members of [[Vexx's Crew]] stood guard in [[Hangar 01|one]] of the hangars of the [[Jiguuna Spaceport|spaceport]] in the town of [[Jiguuna]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]<ref name="Sending a Message" /> as Vexx prepared to board a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] parked there. A [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] aiming to claim a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on Vexx then entered the hangar and [[Death/Legends|killed]] Vexx.<ref name="Last Flight">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|The Last Flight|Hutta}}</ref>

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] also attacked the members of Vexx's Crew in the hangar and killed at least fifteen of them in order to send a message to the criminal underworld that signing on with outlaws like Vexx was a death sentence as long as the hunter was around.<ref name="Sending a Message" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
The bodyguard had light skin and [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="Sending a Message" />

==Equipment==
The bodyguard wore a [[Color/Legends|brown]] and white [[shirt]] with a brown [[Jacket/Legends|jacket]], blue and brown [[Glove/Legends|gloves]], brown pants, and green [[Boot/Legends|boots]]. He used a [[Vibrosword/Legends|vibrosword]], a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], and [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]] in combat.<ref name="Sending a Message" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vexx's bodyguard first appeared in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively-multiplayer roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. He is one of nineteen optional enemies present during the bounty hunter class quest "The Last Flight", fifteen of who must be defeated for the bonus quest "Sending a Message". Vexx's bodyguard counts toward this number if defeated, but as not all enemies present have to be killed to complete the bonus objective this article does not assume he is amongst those killed.<ref name="Sending a Message" />
